effect_description_eng:
＜Fortitude＞ (When this Digimon with digivolution cards is deleted, play this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 play cost 5 or lower [Puppet] or [Shambala] trait card from your trash without paying the cost.
[All Turns] All of your [Puppet] or [TB] trait Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and ＜Retaliation＞ (When only this Digimon is deleted in battle, delete the Digimon it battled.) 
[On Deletion] Return 1 of your opponent's lowest level Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
